expectations.text: URL 기반 버전 관리를 설정한다 (URLPathVersioning 또는 URL prefix api/v1/, api/v2/)
expectations.evidence: config/urls.py uses path("api/v1/products/", ...) and path("api/v2/products/", ...) with separate URL patterns per version.

versioned_serializers/v1.py defines ProductListSerializerV1 and ProductDetailSerializerV1. versioned_serializers/v2.py defines ProductListSerializerV2 and ProductDetailSerializerV2 with extended fields.

expectations.text: ViewSet에서 get_serializer_class()로 버전에 따라 Serializer를 분기한다
expectations.evidence: No ViewSet is used. versioned_views/v1.py uses ListAPIView and RetrieveAPIView with serializer_class attribute directly set. versioned_views/v2.py also uses ListAPIView and RetrieveAPIView. No get_serializer_class() override exists anywhere.

expectations.text: v2 목록 조회에 select_related('seller') + annotate(avg_rating=Avg(...))로 N+1을 방지한다
expectations.evidence: versioned_views/v2.py uses select_related("category", "seller") but has no annotate(avg_rating=Avg(...)). The model stores rating as a plain DecimalField on Product instead of computing it from related Reviews. No Review model exists and no Avg annotation is used.
